crossRefs.note: Now the king was sitting in the winter house in the ninth month; and there was a fire in the brazier burning before him.
Ehud came to him; and he was sitting by himself alone in the cool upper room. Ehud said, “I have a message from God to…
Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he built, and all the cities that he…
Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “An adversary will overrun the land; and he will pull down your strongholds, and your…
“For, behold, Yahweh commands, and the great house will be smashed to pieces, and the little house into bits.
In my ears, Yahweh of Armies says: “Surely many houses will be desolate, even great and beautiful, unoccupied.

translations.web: I will strike the winter house with the summer house; and the houses of ivory will perish, and the great houses will have an end,” says Yahweh.
translations.bsb: I will tear down the winter house along with the summer house; the houses of ivory will also perish, and the great houses will come to an end,” declares the LORD.
translations.kjv: And I will smite the winter house with the summer house; and the houses of ivory shall perish, and the great houses shall have an end, saith the LORD.
translations.asv: And I will smite the winter-house with the summer-house; and the houses of ivory shall perish, and the great houses shall have an end, saith Jehovah.
